newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - U.S. Cellular EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - U.S. Cellular EPS view cut.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Thursday it reduced its 1997 earnings per share estimate on U.S. Cellular Corp by $0.15 to $1.30.
--It also lowered its 1997 EBITDA estimate by about $15 million to $296 million due to its outlook for higher systems operations expenses and marketing costs per gross subscriber added.

--Analyst Thomas Kurey in a report said, "The stock remains attractive at just 7.1 times our projected 1997 EBITDA versus an average 8.3 times for the other non-major metropolitan cellular companies we follow."
